claims: The 2026 Boston Marathon marks the 130th running.
The 2026 Boston Marathon follows the traditional 26.2-mile course.
The 2026 Boston Marathon is on Patriots' Day, April 20, 2026.
The 2026 Boston Marathon starts in Hopkinton.
The 2026 Boston Marathon finishes at Copley Square.
The 2026 Boston Marathon route passes through eight Massachusetts towns: Hopkinton, Ashland, Framingham, Natick, Wellesley, Newton, Brookline, and Boston.
The 2026 Boston Marathon route passes Lake Cochituate.
The 2026 Boston Marathon route passes Heartbreak Hill.
The start of the 2026 Boston Marathon is Main Street in Hopkinton on Route 135.
The 2026 Boston Marathon route follows Route 135 through Ashland, Framingham, Natick, and Wellesley.
The 2026 Boston Marathon route turns right onto Route 16 in Wellesley.
The 2026 Boston Marathon route heads through Newton Lower Falls.
The 2026 Boston Marathon route proceeds along Commonwealth Avenue (Route 30) through the Newton Hills.
The 2026 Boston Marathon route continues on Beacon Street.
The 2026 Boston Marathon route goes onto Chestnut Hill Avenue.
The 2026 Boston Marathon route goes onto Boylston Street at Copley Square.
The 2026 Boston Marathon features staggered start times starting at 9:06 a.m. for Wheelchair Men.
Wave 1 of the 2026 Boston Marathon begins at 10:00 a.m.
Ashland's commuter rail station is a notable spectator location for the 2026 Boston Marathon.
Framingham's downtown area is a notable spectator location for the 2026 Boston Marathon.
Natick center is a notable spectator location for the 2026 Boston Marathon.
Wellesley's "Scream Tunnel" is a notable spectator location for the 2026 Boston Marathon.
The Newton hills are a notable spectator location for the 2026 Boston Marathon.
Major roads along the 2026 Boston Marathon route, such as Beacon Street and Chestnut Hill Ave, will be closed roughly from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.
The MBTA's Framingham/Worcester Line will operate on a special schedule for the 2026 Boston Marathon.
